rotate_envmap: rotate an environment map tensor by specified x, y, z angles in radians using grid sampling
rotate_envmap_vec: rotate an environment map tensor using a Rodrigues rotation vector with axis and angle
rotate_envmap_mat: rotate an environment map tensor using a 3x3 rotation matrix via spherical coordinate remapping
envmap_to_image: project an environment map tensor into a perspective camera image using focal length and principal point
compose_envmap: compose a rendered image with environment map background and mirrorball overlay using camera intrinsics
